messages:
Olivia: quick q — i'm sketching an addition to rollout/pin metadata: add lease_window_ms + telemetry_tags so pins can express a graceful handoff window and we can tie telemetry to pin lifecycles. thoughts?
Matt: can you paste a quick JSON sketch so infra knows what to expect?
Olivia: sure — idea:
```
{
  "pin": {
    "model_id": "redwood-13b-v2",
    "lease_ms": 600000,        // optional, null = current behaviour (no soft lease)
    "evict_on_failure": true, // optional, default true
    "telemetry_tags": ["canary-42", "exp-llm-routing"]
  }
}
```
Sara: main concern: backwards compat + existing pin consumers. we mustn't change eviction semantics if the field is missing.
Kevin: also think about autoscaler interaction — lease should only keep model pinned from deallocation, not block global downscaling if other protections apply. we need clear boundaries.
Annie: telemetry_tags lgtm. lets reuse our eval tag conventions so dashboards can group pins + evals.
infra-bot: schema-check: pins table -> add column lease_ms bigint nullable, evict_on_failure boolean default true, telemetry_tags text[] nullable. migration required.
Matt: implementation note: make lease_ms optional. server enforces an upper cap (24h) to avoid accidental permanent pins. we'll treat null as immediate-evict semantics (current).
Sara: regarding evict_on_failure: if a rollout fails health checks, should the lease be ignored? i'd prefer evict_on_failure = true by default so bad versions don't hold capacity.
Kevin: agree — default true. but also add a per-rollout override so platform teams can opt into preserving state for debugging.
Olivia: good call. owner proposal: matt -> schema + infra tests, sara -> api + sdk, annie -> console + telemetry. i'll write the RFC followup and include migration plan + examples.
Matt: i'll also add a server feature flag to gate the behaviour during rollout (rollout-grace-lease). we can flip after 2w dogfood.
Annie: console note: show lease expiry timestamp and telemetry tags on pin detail page. add quick filter for active-canaries.
infra-bot: action created: MIGRATE-1234 add-lease-telemetry-columns (queued)
Olivia: timeline: RFC note today, schema PR in 48h, api/sdk in 5 days, feature-flagged rollout next week. can we add a small migration backfill to set lease_ms=null for existing pins?
Matt: yep backfill = no-op (null). i'll include a safety script.
Sara: docs: clarify semantics (null = legacy behaviour, lease_ms is soft hold, evict_on_failure overrides lease). also example curl + SDK snippets.
Kevin: small long-term thought: we should consider unifying pin vs anchor semantics (they're drifting). add a follow-up item in the RFC to propose a single metadata contract later.
Olivia: noted — will add a follow-up section. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Matt: ack
Sara: ack
Annie: ack
